Class DoubleRVEA

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.algorithm.rvea.BaseRVEA<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
org.uma.evolver.algorithm.rvea.DoubleRVEA
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseLevelAlgorithm<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
public class DoubleRVEA extends BaseRVEA<org.uma.jmetal.solution.doublesolution.DoubleSolution>
Configurable RVEA for continuous (real-valued) optimization problems.

Extends BaseRVEA for DoubleSolution. The initialisation strategy and variation operator (crossover + mutation) are drawn from a ParameterSpace; RVEA's selection and replacement remain fixed. An optional external archive can be enabled via the algorithmResult parameter in the YAML parameter space.

The population size must match the number of reference vectors supplied, as required by RVEABuilder.
